verdict.rationale: Warp is an HR/payroll platform, so the axis applies. Its marketing says the Warp Agent 'takes... payroll' and asks the user when a decision is theirs, which is a thin first-party claim of running payroll with user approval. Nothing documents the specific run flow. Missing for 10: documented review of hours and earnings, a preview of payroll totals before submit, an explicit submit/approve step in a single flow, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
